- [FACT] User has heard great things about N.T. Wright's writing.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided background on N.T. Wright:
  - Renowned British New Testament scholar and Anglican bishop.
  - Holds a Doctor of Philosophy degree from the University of Oxford.
  - Has taught at several universities, including Cambridge and McGill.
  - Served as the Bishop of Durham from 2003 to 2010.
  - Currently the Chair of New Testament and Early Christianity at the University of St. Andrews in Scotland.
  - Author of over 70 books, including the "For Everyone" series.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] N.T. Wright was inspired to write "Lent for Everyone" to help people engage with the Gospel of Mark during Lent.
